name: Gamester (CR 3)
body:
GAMESTER
CR 3

XP 800
Male human fighter (gamester) 4
LN Medium humanoid (human)
Init +2; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 12, flat-footed 18 (+5 armor, +2 Dex, +3 shield)
hp 38 (4d10+8)
Fort +6; Ref +3; Will +4
Defensive Abilities evasion, uncanny dodge

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee mwk club +9 (1d6+5)

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 14, Con 14, Int 14, Wis 13, Cha 13
Base Atk +4; CMB +7; CMD 19
Feats Combat Expertise B, Iron Will, Shield Focus, Skill Focus (Bluff), Weapon Focus (club), Weapon Specialization (club)
Skills Bluff +11, Disguise +3, Heal +3, Intimidate +8, Perception +5, Perform (act) +8, Sense Motive +8, Survival +8
Languages Common, Dwarven, Goblin
Gear potion of cure moderate wounds; Gear +1 chain shirt, +1 light wooden shield, masterwork club, 2 vials of antitoxin

SPECIAL ABILITIES

None/alter ego.
